## Summary

**Issue:** checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. Reviewed deployment history — v2.3.1 (unhealthy) was the latest production deploy; **v2.3.0** was the most recent healthy production release.
2. Rolled back all production regions to **v2.3.0**.
3. Verified recovery: service is healthy in all regions, error rate dropped from 18% → 0.2%.
4. Opened **SEV2 incident INC-0001** documenting the outage, the rollback, and a note that v2.3.1 should not be redeployed until root cause is identified. (The creation call timed out, but verification confirmed it was successfully registered — I did not duplicate it.)
